Asset type: one square vocabulary illustration.
Exact target sense: hillside / n. / 山坡.
Primary request: A single broad green hillside rising diagonally from low foreground to a rounded hilltop, seen from its side, with a winding footpath and a few small trees for scale. The slope is dominant, gentle ordinary hill not a jagged mountain.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, soft natural light and muted natural colors.
Composition: one clear subject or tightly related scene centered within the middle 70 percent, generous blank paper margin, legible at small card size.
Constraints: communicate this exact meaning visually without relying on any word or explanation. No letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, frame, card UI or unrelated decorative objects.
